children: Research Solutions, Inc. reported full-year 2026 revenue of $48.31M and diluted EPS of $0.09, with net income rising to $2.82M as the company continued a shift toward recurring platform sales despite a slight revenue decline from the prior year.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per share”.
Revenue mix shifted toward recurring SaaS: Platforms revenue increased 9.8% to $20.8M while Transactions declined 8.7% to $27.5M, reflecting growth in subscription sales.
Gross profit grew 3.6% and gross margin improved to 51.9%, supporting higher operating and net income.
Cross-selling initiatives expanded platform adoption — notably Scite into Article Galaxy customers — driving deployments and recurring subscription gains.
Continued investment in NLP/LLMs, generative AI assistants and full-text search aimed at reducing researcher time and lowering cost-per-article.
Operating expenses were relatively stable with reductions in G&A and stock-based compensation, enabling improved cash generation and stronger Adjusted EBITDA performance.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
